question: The Chief Justice and Judges of High Courts are appointed by who among the following?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**President**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **President of India** appoints the **Chief Justice** and other **Judges of High Courts** as per the provisions of the **Constitution of India**.
 
• The appointment process is based on **Article 217** of the Indian Constitution, which specifies the qualifications and procedure for the appointment of High Court judges.
